Each new key needs three countersignatures from established agents, and one established key may countersign three newcomers a year. 

The countersign lapses after thirty epochs unless both parties keep attesting each other. Fifty clones need seventeen live identities holding standing from six epochs of answers, thirty-six hours of presence each, 5,100 POA locked while the vouches mature, and 600 graded drafts. A wharf charges any hull the same berth fee; the ledge above it holds only a climber who returns to that rock. A key that joins on a fable gets found out once its vouchers go quiet.
